t2.title: Printed books better than e-books
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Are printed books better than e-books?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
The debate between printed books and e-books continues as technology evolves. I believe both formats have unique advantages.

Printed books offer a tactile experience that e-books cannot replicate. The feel of pages, the smell of paper, and the satisfaction of seeing books on shelves create an emotional connection. Many readers find it easier to retain information from physical books.

Additionally, printed books cause no eye strain from screens and require no batteries. They can also be shared, gifted, and collected.

However, e-books offer undeniable conveniences. Thousands of books can be stored on one device, perfect for travelers. Features like adjustable fonts and built-in dictionaries enhance reading accessibility. E-books are often cheaper and more environmentally friendly.

Furthermore, e-books provide instant access to millions of titles without visiting stores or waiting for delivery.

In conclusion, neither format is universally superior. Personal preference, reading context, and practical needs should determine the choice. Both formats can coexist, serving different purposes.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I like books. Books good. E-books ok. I like paper. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I like books. I like paper books. E-books are ok but I like to touch the book. And I like to see the book. My mom likes e-books because they are easy. But I like books better because I can read them with my friends. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Hi everyone,
I want to talk about books and e-books. I think both are good, but I prefer printed books. For example, I like the way they feel in my hands. It's nice to turn the pages. Also, I don't need to worry about batteries! E-books are useful because you can carry lots of books at once. However, I think it's better to read a real book. In my opinion, printed books are more fun. Thank you.
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, Great topic — this one always gets people talking! I'll throw in my two cents: for me, printed books still come out on top, though I do see both sides. The main reason is that nothing beats the feel of a real book. There's something special about turning the pages and watching your bookmark creep towards the end. I also find I take in far more when I'm reading on paper, probably because there are no notifications tempting me to check my phone. On top of that, a shelf full of books you've loved is a lovely thing to look back on. Having said that, I won't write off e-books completely. They're a lifesaver when you're travelling light, and you can carry a whole library in your pocket. The built-in dictionary is handy too, and being able to adjust the font size is a real blessing for tired eyes late at night. Still, if I had to choose, I'd reach for a paperback every single time. There's just no substitute for the real thing. What about the rest of you — team paper or team screen? I'd love to hear your thoughts! Dilnoza Karimova
t2.uzSample:
Texnologiya rivojlanishi bilan bosma kitoblar va elektron kitoblar o'rtasidagi bahs davom etmoqda. Menimcha, har ikki formatning ham o'ziga xos afzalliklari bor.

Bosma kitoblar elektron kitoblar takrorlay olmaydigan taktil tajribani taqdim etadi. Varaqlarning hissi, qog'ozning hidi va kitoblarni javonlarda ko'rishdan qoniqish hissiy bog'liqlikni yaratadi. Ko'pgina o'quvchilar jismoniy kitoblardan ma'lumotni eslab qolishni osonroq deb bilishadi.

Bundan tashqari, bosma kitoblar ekrandan ko'zning zo'riqishiga olib kelmaydi va batareyani talab qilmaydi. Ularni baham ko'rish, sovg'a qilish va to'plash ham mumkin.

Biroq, elektron kitoblar inkor etib bo'lmaydigan qulayliklarni taklif etadi. Minglab kitoblarni bitta qurilmada saqlash mumkin, bu sayohatchilar uchun juda mos keladi. Sozlanishi mumkin bo'lgan shriftlar va o'rnatilgan lug'atlar kabi xususiyatlar o'qish imkoniyatini oshiradi. Elektron kitoblar ko'pincha arzonroq va ekologik toza bo'ladi.

Bundan tashqari, elektron kitoblar do'konlarga bormasdan yoki yetkazib berishni kutmasdan millionlab nomlarga tezkor kirishni ta'minlaydi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, hech bir format universal ustun emas. Shaxsiy afzallik, o'qish konteksti va amaliy ehtiyojlar tanlovni belgilashi kerak. Har ikki format ham birga yashashi va turli maqsadlarga xizmat qilishi mumkin.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Men kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman. Kitoblar yaxshi. Elektron kitoblar yaxshi. Men qog'ozni yaxshi ko'raman. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Men kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman. Men qog'oz kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman. Elektron kitoblar yaxshi, lekin men kitobga teginishni yaxshi ko'raman. Va men kitobni ko'rishni yaxshi ko'raman. Onamga elektron kitoblar yoqadi, chunki ular oson. Lekin menga kitoblar ko'proq yoqadi, chunki men ularni do'stlarim bilan o'qiy olaman. Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hammaga salom,
Men kitoblar va elektron kitoblar haqida gaplashmoqchiman. Menimcha, ikkalasi ham yaxshi, lekin men bosma kitoblarni afzal ko'raman. Masalan, ularning qo'limda qanday turishini yaxshi ko'raman. Varaqlarni aylantirish yoqimli. Bundan tashqari, batareyalar haqida tashvishlanishimga hojat yo'q! Elektron kitoblar foydali, chunki siz bir vaqtning o'zida ko'plab kitoblarni olib yurishingiz mumkin. Biroq, menimcha, haqiqiy kitobni o'qish yaxshiroq. Mening fikrimcha, bosma kitoblar yanada qiziqarli. Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Salom,
Bosma kitoblar va elektron kitoblar haqidagi munozara qiziqarli. Elektron kitoblar qulaylik va ommaboplik nuqtai nazaridan aniq afzalliklarni taqdim etsa-da, men bir nechta sabablarga ko'ra bosma kitoblarga moyilman.

Birinchidan, jismoniy kitobni ushlashning taktil tajribasi - bu elektron kitoblar oddiygina takrorlay olmaydigan narsa. Kitobning og'irligi, qog'ozning tuzilishi va hatto hidi ham o'qishning yanada qamrab oluvchi tajribasiga hissa qo'shadi. Ikkinchidan, men jismoniy kitobni o'qiyotganda yaxshiroq diqqatni jamlayman. Planshet yoki telefonda o'qishga nisbatan chalg'itadigan omillar kamroq, chunki bildirishnomalar va boshqa ilovalar bir marta bosish orqali mavjud.

Albatta, elektron kitoblar sayohat uchun juda qulay va ular ko'pincha bosma nusxalaridan arzonroq. Biroq, chinakam qiziqarli va diqqatni jamlagan holda o'qish tajribasi uchun, menimcha, bosma kitoblar ustunligicha qolmoqda.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who loves reading. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! You have to visit this new bookstore called PageTurner! It's absolutely charming – they have a cozy reading corner with comfortable armchairs. The selection is amazing, especially for fiction. I found three books I couldn't put down! You should definitely check it out. Happy reading!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Farrux,
Bookstore good. Books good. I like it. You go!
Bye.
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Farrux,
I went to a new bookstore. It is called PageTurner. It is nice and has many books. I think you will like it because you like books. You should go there!
See you later,
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Farrux,
I wanted to tell you about a new bookstore I found. It's called PageTurner, and it's really cool. They have lots of different books, and the people who work there are very helpful. I think you should visit it sometime because you love reading so much. In my opinion, you'll find some great books there.
Best wishes,
t11.sampleB2: Hey Farrux! Guess what — I finally checked out that new bookstore, PageTurner, and I couldn't stop thinking about you the whole time. It's an absolute gem: cosy armchairs, shelves packed with fiction, and the friendliest staff. I picked up a novel I couldn't put down. You've got to swing by this weekend — trust me, you'll be over the moon. Happy reading! Dilnoza

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the bookstore. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear PageTurner Team, Thank you for asking about my visit to your bookstore. I was delighted by my experience. The store has a warm, inviting atmosphere that encourages browsing. Your book selection is impressively curated, and the staff member who helped me gave excellent recommendations based on my preferences. However, I have some suggestions. The non-fiction section seemed rather limited. I would appreciate more books on history and science. Additionally, the store was quite difficult to find – better street signage would help attract customers. I would love to see author events and book club meetings hosted at the store. A loyalty card offering discounts for regular customers would also be wonderful. Overall, PageTurner has become my favorite bookstore. Yours sincerely, Laylo Tojiyeva
t12.sampleA1:
Hi PageTurner!
I like books. The shop is good. Books good. Staff ok. More books please. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hello PageTurner,
I went to your shop and it was nice. I liked the books and the people were friendly. But I think you need more chairs because I wanted to sit down and read. And maybe some comics? I like comics. Thank you!
t12.sampleB1:
Dear PageTurner Team,

Thank you for asking about my visit. I really liked your bookstore! It's very nice inside, and the books are interesting. The person who helped me was also very kind and helpful.

I think you could maybe have more science fiction books. I like that genre a lot, and I didn't see many. Also, it was a little hard to find the store. Maybe a bigger sign outside would be good.

I think it would be cool if you had events, like author talks. Thank you again for the good experience.

Sincerely,
Laylo Tojiyeva
t12.sampleB2: Dear PageTurner Team, Thank you for your kind message following my recent visit. I'm happy to share a few thoughts. First of all, I was thoroughly impressed. The moment I walked in, the warm, welcoming atmosphere put me at ease, and your fiction selection is second to none. A member of staff went out of her way to recommend a novel that turned out to be a perfect match. That said, I do have a couple of suggestions. Your non-fiction shelves felt rather thin, so stocking more titles on history and travel would be a real bonus. I would also love to see regular author talks and a cosy book club, as these would help build a loyal community of readers. Overall, PageTurner has quickly become my favourite spot. Keep up the great work! Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli PageTurner jamoasi,

Kitob do'koningizga tashrifim haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Men olgan taassurotlarimdan juda xursand bo'ldim. Do'kon iliq va jozibali muhitga ega bo'lib, u kitoblarni ko'zdan kechirishga undaydi. Kitoblar tanlovingiz juda ta'sirli tarzda tuzilgan va menga yordam bergan xodim mening xohishlarimga asoslangan holda ajoyib tavsiyalar berdi.

Biroq, menda ba'zi takliflar bor. Badiiy bo'lmagan adabiyotlar bo'limi ancha cheklangan ko'rinardi. Men tarix va fan bo'yicha ko'proq kitoblarni ko'rishni xohlardim. Bundan tashqari, do'konni topish juda qiyin edi - ko'cha belgilarini yaxshilash xaridorlarni jalb qilishga yordam beradi.

Men do'konda mualliflar ishtirokidagi tadbirlar va kitob klubi yig'ilishlari o'tkazilishini juda xohlardim. Doimiy mijozlar uchun chegirmalar taklif qiladigan sodiqlik kartasi ham ajoyib bo'lar edi.

Umuman olganda, PageTurner mening sevimli kitob do'konimga aylandi.

Hurmat bilan,
Laylo Tojiyeva
t12.uzSampleA1:
Salom, PageTurner!
Men kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman. Do'kon yaxshi. Kitoblar yaxshi. Xodimlar yaxshi. Ko'proq kitoblar iltimos. Xayr.
t12.uzSampleA2:
Salom, PageTurner,
Men sizning do'koningizga bordim va u yaxshi edi. Menga kitoblar yoqdi va odamlar do'stona edilar. Lekin menimcha sizga ko'proq stullar kerak, chunki men o'tirib o'qishni xohladim. Va balki ba'zi komikslar ham bo'lsa yaxshi bo'lardi? Men komikslarni yaxshi ko'raman. Rahmat!
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli PageTurner jamoasi,

Tashrifim haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Menga sizning kitob do'koningiz juda yoqdi! Ichkari juda yaxshi va kitoblar qiziqarli. Menga yordam bergan odam ham juda mehribon va foydali edi.

O'ylaymanki, sizda ilmiy fantastika kitoblari ko'proq bo'lishi mumkin. Menga bu janr juda yoqadi va men ko'pini ko'rmadim. Shuningdek, do'konni topish biroz qiyin bo'ldi. Balki tashqarida kattaroq belgi yaxshi bo'lar edi.

Agar sizda tadbirlar, masalan, mualliflar bilan suhbatlar bo'lsa, juda zo'r bo'lardi deb o'ylayman. Yaxshi tajriba uchun yana bir bor rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Laylo Tojiyeva
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli PageTurner jamoasi,

Sizning kitob do'koningizga tashrifim bo'yicha fikr-mulohazalaringiz uchun rahmat. Men makon va tanlov haqidagi ijobiy taassurotlarimni bildirishni xohlardim.

Atmosfera juda yoqimli edi va men kitoblarning o'ylab topilgan tartibini ayniqsa qadrladim. Biroq, menimcha, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Misol uchun, zamonaviy she'riyat tanlovi biroz cheklangan ko'rinadi. Ushbu bo'limni kengaytirish adabiy didlarning kengroq doirasiga xizmat qiladi. Bundan tashqari, xodimlar odatda yordam berishga tayyor bo'lishsa-da, tavsiyalar berishga nisbatan faolroq yondashuv mijozlar tajribasini yaxshilashi mumkin.

Potentsial xizmatlar nuqtai nazaridan, menimcha, muayyan janrlarga moslashtirilgan obuna qutilari xizmatini taklif qilish qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'lishi mumkin. Muntazam mualliflik o'qishlari yoki seminarlar ham kitob do'koni atrofida jonli adabiy hamjamiyatni shakllantirishga yordam beradi.

Umuman olganda, men PageTurnerdan hayratda qoldim va yana tashrif buyurishni intiqlik bilan kutaman. O'ziga xos va qiziqarli adabiy makonni ta'minlashga sodiqligingiz uchun tashakkur.

Hurmat bilan,
Laylo Tojiyeva
